title: Pull-back bound for the coefficient norm: |A^#β| ≤ ‖A‖^k·|β| (parent (L1))
statement: Let N, N', k ∈ ℕ, let A : ℝ^N → ℝ^{N'} be a continuous linear map (A : Euclid N →L[ℝ] Euclid N') with operator norm ‖A‖, and let β be a k-covector on ℝ^{N'} (Covector (Euclid N') k). Let A^#β := β.compContinuousLinearMap A be the pull-back, A^#β(w_1, …, w_k) = β(Aw_1, …, Aw_k). Then |A^#β| ≤ ‖A‖^k·|β|, where |α| = covectorEuclideanNorm α is the Euclidean norm of the values of α on the strictly increasing tuples of standard basis vectors of the respective space.
lean_statement: ∀ (N N' k : ℕ) (A : Euclid N →L[ℝ] Euclid N') (β : Covector (Euclid N') k), covectorEuclideanNorm (β.compContinuousLinearMap A) ≤ ‖A‖ ^ k * covectorEuclideanNorm β
